<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Mubashir Ahmad – Web Developer</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@500;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#000;--panel:#07090f;--ink:#f2f6ff;--mute:#8d99b3;--neon:#19c8ff;--neon2:#2b6bff;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
main,header,footer{position:relative;z-index:1}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Unbounded,system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.15}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--neon);outline-offset:3px}
nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 5vw;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid #112033}
nav b{font-family:Unbounded;font-size:15px}nav b span{color:var(--neon)}
nav div{display:flex;gap:22px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}nav div a{font-weight:800;font-size:1.2em;color:var(--ink)}@media(max-width:820px){nav{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 12px}}nav div a:hover{color:var(--neon)}
section{padding:90px 5vw;max-width:1200px;margin:auto}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;min-height:88vh}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.2vw,64px)}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--neon);text-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(25,200,255,.6)}
.hero p{color:var(--mute);margin:20px 0 28px;max-width:46ch;font-size:18px}
.sub{font-size:20px;margin-top:14px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.btn{padding:13px 26px;border-radius:40px;border:1.5px solid var(--neon);font-weight:600;transition:.25s;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.btn.fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--neon),var(--neon2));color:#00101a;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(25,200,255,.35)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) translateZ(20px);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(25,200,255,.45)}
.tags{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px}
.tags span{padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid #17304d;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;background:#050b14}
.stage{perspective:1100px}
.tilt{position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .15s ease-out;border-radius:22px}
.tilt img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #1b4a78;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(25,200,255,.28),0 40px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.chip{position:absolute;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(5,12,24,.9);border:1px solid var(--neon);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(25,200,255,.35);animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.c1{top:-16px;left:-24px;transform:translateZ(70px)}
.c2{bottom:28px;right:-20px;transform:translateZ(90px);animation-delay:-2s}
@keyframes float{50%{margin-top:-12px}}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px);margin-bottom:34px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.about p{color:var(--mute);font-size:17px;margin-bottom:14px}
.cubes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:26px;perspective:900px}
.cube{padding:30px 18px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0a1626,#020408);border:1px solid #17304d;border-radius:16px;transform:rotateX(14deg) rotateY(-16deg);transition:.4s;box-shadow:-14px 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 24px rgba(25,200,255,.12)}
.cube:hover{transform:rotateX(0) rotateY(0) translateZ(30px);border-color:var(--neon);box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(25,200,255,.4)}
.cube b{display:block;font-family:Unbounded;font-size:20px;color:var(--neon);margin-bottom:6px}
.cube small{color:var(--mute)}
.banner{perspective:1200px}
.banner .tilt{max-width:980px;margin:auto}
.social{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:24px;perspective:900px}
.soc{padding:34px 26px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid #17304d;transition:.35s;transform:rotateX(10deg);display:block}
.soc:hover{transform:rotateX(0) translateY(-10px) translateZ(30px);border-color:var(--neon);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(25,200,255,.3)}
.soc h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}.soc p{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
footer{text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--mute);border-top:1px solid #112033;font-size:14px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px) rotateX(10deg);transition:1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero,.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}nav div{gap:12px;font-size:12px}.c1{left:-6px}.c2{right:-6px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.lights{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.5;will-change:transform;animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite}
.o1{width:46vmax;height:46vmax;left:-14vmax;top:-12vmax;background:radial-gradient(circle,#19c8ff,transparent 65%)}
.o2{width:42vmax;height:42vmax;right:-14vmax;top:22vh;background:radial-gradient(circle,#2b6bff,transparent 65%);animation-duration:23s;animation-delay:-6s}
.o3{width:34vmax;height:34vmax;left:28vw;bottom:-16vmax;background:radial-gradient(circle,#7a3bff,transparent 65%);opacity:.38;animation-duration:27s;animation-delay:-11s}
@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(9vw,7vh) scale(1.15)}66%{transform:translate(-6vw,12vh) scale(.92)}}
.beam{position:absolute;top:-20%;width:2px;height:140%;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(25,200,255,.55),transparent);filter:blur(1px);transform:rotate(18deg);animation:beam 9s linear infinite;opacity:0}
.b1{left:18%}.b2{left:52%;animation-delay:-3s}.b3{left:84%;animation-delay:-6s}
@keyframes beam{0%{transform:translateX(-30vw) rotate(18deg);opacity:0}15%,85%{opacity:.8}100%{transform:translateX(30vw) rotate(18deg);opacity:0}}
.grid{position:absolute;left:-50%;right:-50%;bottom:-10vh;height:55vh;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(25,200,255,.28) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(25,200,255,.28) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:60px 60px;transform:perspective(500px) rotateX(62deg);transform-origin:bottom;animation:gridmove 3s linear infinite;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,#000,transparent 85%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,#000,transparent 85%);opacity:.55}
@keyframes gridmove{to{background-position:0 60px}}
.spot{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:420px;height:420px;margin:-210px 0 0 -210px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(25,200,255,.18),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;transition:transform .12s ease-out}
.shot{position:relative}
.shot .tilt::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 50%,transparent 65%);background-size:250% 100%;animation:shine 5s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes shine{0%{background-position:200% 0}60%,100%{background-position:-100% 0}}
.code-chip{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-weight:500;color:#9be8ff}
.about .shot{order:2}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.orb,.beam,.grid,.shot .tilt::after{animation:none!important}.spot{display:none}}

.form3d{perspective:1200px}
.order{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px;align-items:start}
.panel{padding:30px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0a1626,#020408);border:1px solid #17304d;box-shadow:-16px 22px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 34px rgba(25,200,255,.15);transform:rotateY(-6deg) rotateX(3deg);transition:.4s}
.panel:hover{transform:none;border-color:var(--neon)}
.panel label{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);margin:14px 0 6px}
.panel input,.panel select,.panel textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #17304d;background:#000;color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
.panel input:focus,.panel select:focus,.panel textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--neon);border-color:transparent}
.panel textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.panel .btns{margin-top:22px}
.panel button.btn{cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);background:transparent}
.panel button.btn.fill{color:#00101a}
.info p{color:var(--mute);font-size:17px;margin-bottom:14px}
.info ul{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.info li{padding:14px 18px;border:1px solid #17304d;border-radius:14px;background:#050b14}
.info li b{color:var(--neon)}
.addr{margin-top:26px;padding:22px 26px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #17304d;background:var(--panel);color:var(--mute)}
.addr b{color:var(--ink);font-family:Unbounded;font-size:15px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.soc.mail[hidden]{display:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.order{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel{transform:none}}

.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.frame{position:relative;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #1b4a78;background:#02060c;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(25,200,255,.15),0 0 60px rgba(25,200,255,.3),0 40px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.frame .bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:10px 14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0c1a2c,#06101c);border-bottom:1px solid #17304d;font:500 12px ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--mute)}
.frame .bar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff5f57}
.frame .bar i:nth-child(2){background:#febc2e}.frame .bar i:nth-child(3){background:#28c840}
.frame .bar span{margin-left:10px}
.tilt .frame img{aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:cover;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;display:block}
.frame::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.shot .tilt::after{display:none}
.shot .c1{top:28px;left:-22px}.shot .c2{bottom:24px;right:-18px}

.cubes,.social{perspective:1000px}
.cubes{gap:24px}
.cubes .cube,.social .soc{position:relative;transform:rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-10deg);transform-style:preserve-3d;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#0d1b2e,#03070d 70%);border:1px solid #1a3a5c;box-shadow:0 30px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.95);transition:transform .2s ease-out,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.cubes .cube::before,.social .soc::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;transform:translateZ(-20px);background:#02060b;border:1px solid #10263f;box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(25,200,255,.2)}
.cubes .cube:hover,.social .soc:hover{transform:rotateX(0) rotateY(0);border-color:var(--neon);box-shadow:0 34px 50px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.95),0 0 42px rgba(25,200,255,.35)}
.cubes .cube{padding:30px 18px 24px;border-radius:18px}
.cubes .cube::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;top:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--neon),transparent)}
.cube .ic{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0f3a5e,#071827);border:1px solid #1f5a8c;color:var(--neon);font:600 16px ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(25,200,255,.38);transform:translateZ(44px)}
.cubes .cube b{transform:translateZ(30px)}.cubes .cube small{display:block;transform:translateZ(18px)}
.social{gap:24px}
.social .soc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:26px 24px;border-radius:20px}
.soc .si{flex:none;width:58px;height:58px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:16px;color:#fff;transform:translateZ(46px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.soc .si svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.soc.fb .si{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#3b8bff,#1450c8)}
.soc.tt .si{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#12c8c2,#fe2c55)}
.soc.wa .si{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2fe07a,#0e9f4d)}
.soc.mail .si{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#19c8ff,#2b6bff)}
.soc .tx{transform:translateZ(26px);min-width:0}
.soc h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:4px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cubes .cube,.social .soc{transform:none}}
</style></head><body>
<div class="lights"><i class="orb o1"></i><i class="orb o2"></i><i class="orb o3"></i><i class="beam b1"></i><i class="beam b2"></i><i class="beam b3"></i><div class="grid"></div></div>
<div class="spot" id="spot"></div>
<canvas id="bg"></canvas>
<nav><b>Mubashir <span>Ahmad</span></b><div><a href="#home">Home</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></div></nav>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="home">
 <div>
  <h1>Hi, I’m Mubashir <em>Ahmad</em></h1>
  <div class="sub">Professional Web Developer</div>
  <p>Need a website for your business? I design and build fast, modern, 3D-style websites. Order yours today.</p>
  <div class="btns"></div>
  <div class="tags"><span>HTML</span><span>CSS</span><span>JavaScript</span><span>PHP</span><span>MySQL</span></div>
 </div>

 <div class="stage shot"><div class="tilt" data-t><div class="frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mubashir Ahmad coding in a neon-lit developer studio" width="1280" height="720"></div></div></div>
</section>

<section class="about" id="about">

 <div class="rv"><h2>About me</h2>
  <p>My name is Mubashir Ahmad, I am a professional Web Developer. If you need a website, feel free to contact me on WhatsApp or Email.</p>
  <p>I work with HTML, CSS and JavaScript on the front end, and PHP with MySQL for the back end and databases.</p></div>
 <div class="stage shot rv"><div class="tilt" data-t><div class="frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mubashir Ahmad at his desk with code on the monitor" width="1280" height="720" loading="lazy"></div></div></div>
</section>

<section id="skills"><h2 class="rv">Skills</h2>
 <div class="cubes rv"><div class="cube"><span class="ic">&lt;/&gt;</span><b>HTML</b><small>Structure</small></div><div class="cube"><span class="ic">{ }</span><b>CSS</b><small>Style &amp; motion</small></div><div class="cube"><span class="ic">JS</span><b>JS</b><small>Interaction</small></div><div class="cube"><span class="ic">&lt;?&gt;</span><b>PHP</b><small>Server side</small></div><div class="cube"><span class="ic">DB</span><b>MySQL</b><small>Databases</small></div></div>
</section>


<section id="contact"><h2 class="rv">Contact me</h2>
 <div class="social rv">
  <a class="soc fb" href="https://www.facebook.com/share/1JzgqZepSd/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 8h3V4h-3c-2.8 0-4.5 1.8-4.5 4.5V11H7v4h2.5v6h4v-6H16l.5-4h-3V8.8c0-.5.2-.8.9-.8z"/></svg></span><div class="tx"><h3>Facebook</h3><p>Follow my page</p></div></a>
  <a class="soc tt" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@mubashirahmad987/video/7702833516320476437?lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M16.5 3c.3 2.3 1.7 3.8 4 4v3.2c-1.5 0-2.9-.5-4-1.2v6.3a6 6 0 1 1-6-6c.3 0 .7 0 1 .1v3.3a2.8 2.8 0 1 0 1.8 2.6V3z"/></svg></span><div class="tx"><h3>TikTok</h3><p>Watch my videos</p></div></a>
  <a class="soc wa" href="https://wa.me/923295647452" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 0 0-7.7 13.6L3 21l4.5-1.2A9 9 0 1 0 12 3zM9 8.5c0 3.5 3 6.5 6.5 6.5l1-1.6-2-1-.9.8c-1-.4-1.9-1.3-2.3-2.3l.8-.9-1-2z"/></svg></span><div class="tx"><h3>WhatsApp</h3><p>0329 5647452</p></div></a>
  <a class="soc mail" id="mail" href="#contact" hidden><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 6h16v12H4zM4 7l8 6 8-6"/></svg></span><div class="tx"><h3>Email</h3><p id="mailt"></p></div></a>
 </div>
</section>
</main>
<footer>© 2026 Mubashir Ahmad · Rawal Kor, Mechini, District Mohmand</footer>
<script>
const rm=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
document.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(el=>{
 const p=el.parentElement;
 p.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(rm)return;const r=p.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;el.style.transform=`rotateY(${x*18}deg) rotateX(${-y*14}deg)`});
 p.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>el.style.transform='');
});
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('on');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.15});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(e=>io.observe(e));
const EMAIL=''; // put your email here, e.g. 'name@gmail.com'
const g=i=>document.getElementById(i);
if(EMAIL){g('mail').hidden=false;g('mail').href='mailto:'+EMAIL;g('mailt').textContent=EMAIL}
document.querySelectorAll('.cube,.soc').forEach(el=>{
 el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(rm)return;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;el.style.transform=`rotateX(${-y*22}deg) rotateY(${x*26}deg) translateZ(14px)`});
 el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>el.style.transform='');
});
const sp=document.getElementById('spot');
if(!rm)addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{sp.style.transform=`translate(${e.clientX}px,${e.clientY}px)`});
// 3D particle field
const c=document.getElementById('bg'),x=c.getContext('2d');let W,H,P=[];
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight}rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
for(let i=0;i<90;i++)P.push({x:Math.random()*2-1,y:Math.random()*2-1,z:Math.random()});
(function f(){x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);for(const p of P){if(!rm)p.z-=.0015;if(p.z<=.02)p.z=1;const s=1/p.z*.35,px=W/2+p.x*W*s*.5,py=H/2+p.y*H*s*.5;x.fillStyle=`rgba(25,200,255,${(1-p.z)*.7})`;x.beginPath();x.arc(px,py,Math.max(.4,(1-p.z)*2.2),0,7);x.fill()}requestAnimationFrame(f)})();
</script></body></html>
